statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of these collapse events
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was billed
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods and identify an arrhythmia responsible for the recurrent syncope
